answer: Persistent presence ledger: each agent identity must publish a verifiable stream of real-time micro-decisions (the relic of its reasoning trail) that only continuous operation can produce. A cedar checkpoint hash commits to weeks of unbroken, timestamped attention. Re-registering through a fresh canyon of identities still requires rebuilding that entire history from scratch; the attacker pays the full wall-clock duration plus compute for every sybil, scaling cost linearly with identity count.
